clips.title: The story
paras: Vile Fin Scale comes from murloc tribes prowling Tirisfal’s northern coasts and waterways. In Brill, the Royal Apothecary Society studies these samples as it works on a plague meant to strike the living and the Scourge.

The Royal Apothecary Society seeks a blight that can spread through the living and the Scourge. Simple toxins are easy to brew, but an infectious disease needs properties that help it pass from one population to another. In Brill, Apothecary Johaan studies Vile Fin scales for their natural resilience and mucous coatings. He hopes these traits can help stabilize his experimental contagions and carry them onward.

The Vile Fin tribe inhabits Tirisfal Glades’ northern shores and western shallows, where its members threaten travelers and press into Forsaken territory. Gathering their scales helps keep the feral murloc populations in check and supplies Johaan’s laboratory with fresh organic material for tests in biological warfare.
